message: ミッション　in　オードブル

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, Ria-senpai. It's not time to meet up yet, is it?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah... Actually, I'm in a bit of trouble」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't tell me you can't find the ingredients」

name: Ria
message: 「That's exactly it. I opened the fridge just now and it was completely empty. Even though there was still food left this morning」

name: Synn
message: 「Someone must have eaten it all, then」

name: Paqy
message: 「Speaking of the kind of person who'd pull something like this...」

name: Synn
message: 「Even Helena-san wouldn't go that far, come on」

name: Paqy
message: 「You already know who it is, don't ya」

name: Helena
message: 「Good morning, members of the Student Council」

name: Ria
message: 「Here we go again...」

name: Helena
message: 「I have taken the hostages. If you want them back--BEEEEP」

name: Ria
message: 「Alright, hazardous material recovered\s10」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nice one, Ria-chan」

name: Synn
message: 「What are we going to do, Senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm. I guess we have no choice but to go shopping」

name: Synn
message: 「She did say she's holding them hostage, so let's make her give them back」

name: Synn
message: 「It'd be such a waste!」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, you're right\s07」
Senpai rewinds the tape recorder a little.

name: Helena
message: 「If you want them returned, you will follow my instructions to the letter」

name: Ria
message: 「So, running errands」

name: Helena
message: 「Let's see... First is wine. I want you to get some wine ready」

name: Synn
message: 「Are we her errand boys now」

name: Helena
message: 「I feel bad making children buy it, but this too is a mission」

name: Ria
message: 「Some mission」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, this is a problem. Looking like this, there's no way I can buy alcohol」

name: Synn
message: 「It'll be fine」

name: Ria
message: 「You think so?」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's just head over first」

name: Synn
message: 「Got the wine!」
Nakago Liquor Store. He comes out cradling several bottles of wine in both arms.

name: Ria
message: 「Amazing...! Are you okay? They didn't yell at you for being in uniform?」

name: Synn
message: 「The old man at the liquor store knows I don't drink, so it's fine」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh~. You know him」

name: Synn
message: 「I bring empty bottles here all the time, after all. Hup」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, want me to carry some?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm good」

name: Ria
message: 「Thanks, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「I hope this is the end of it, though」

name: Ria
message: 「She did say, '\{First of all|\s12\s12\s12}' and all...」
Looking fed up, he plays the tape recorder.

name: Helena
message: 「It seems you've acquired it without issue. Next, head to the bakery and buy some baguettes for me」

name: Synn
message: 「Is Helena-san more of a Western-food person?」

name: Ria
message: 「I might be starting to get a slight bad feeling about this」

name: Ria
message: 「Got the baguettes\s04」
Inside the paper bag Ria-senpai is holding, the baguette brothers are snuggling up cozily together.

name: Ria
message: 「So super soft and fluffy\s05」

name: Synn
message: 「They don't really feel like baguettes unless they're hard, do they?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You've just never had it fresh and fluffy」

name: Synn
message: 「Hehehe, I knew you'd say that. But I've actually had it fresh and fluffy before, you know」

name: Ria
message: 「Fresh out of the oven is so good~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. When you buy some and pop it in the toaster oven」

name: Ria
message: 「Uh-huh, popping it in the toaster oven」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey now. That ain't fresh-baked」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not?」

name: Ria
message: 「That's just reheating it. Freshly baked is way more delicious\s05」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that how it works--」

name: Ria
message: 「Wanna try a little bite? Here you go」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, are you sure!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Actually, I kinda wanted to sneak a bite myself, you see\s07」
Senpai sticks out her tongue playfully.

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Now you're officially accomplices」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez, I'm not giving any to you then, Paa-chan」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's cold, Ria-chan!」

name: Ria
message: 「Here, say aah」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh」

name: Ria
message: 「Both your hands are full, right.

name: Ria
message: Say aah」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Aaah\S01」
Whoa! My lips just brushed against Senpai's fingers.

name: Ria
message: 「Is it good?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nom nom... It's delicious\s03」

name: Ria
message: 「Great. Then I'll have some too ♪」
Smiling brightly, she tore off a piece of the baguette using the same fingers she'd just used to feed me, and ate it.
Ah, Senpai, if you bring it that close to your mouth, your fingers are going to touch your lips!

name: Ria
message: 「Giggle, it's delicious.」

name: Ria
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, it's nothing.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey! Let me lick Ria-chan's fingers too!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, Paqy!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah... Did I... touch you? I-I'm sorry\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, it's totally fine! Besides, it tasted great.」

name: Paqy
message: 「They're Ria-chan's fingers, of course they taste great, you bastard!!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not what I meant! I meant the bread!\s01」

name: Paqy
message: 「AAAAAAHHHHH, I wanna be fed 'ahhh' by Ria-chan tooooooo!」

name: Ria
message: 「G-Geez... Bad dog!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Silence...」
I'm just going to dig my own grave if I say anything else, so I'd better stay quiet...

name: Synn
message: 「S-Senpai. Let's get back to the tape.」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-Yeah.」

name: Helena
message: 「Things are getting quite steamy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Pfft!」

name: Helena
message: 「Mhm, that's a fine baguette. Alright, I'll take cheese fondue next, please.」

name: Synn
message: 「Cough, cough!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, are you okay?」
Is Helena-san watching us from somewhere...?

name: Ria
message: 「We got cheese fondue.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「What's that?」

name: Ria
message: 「It's cheese melted with white wine until it's nice and gooey. You dip bread in it to eat.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, so that's why we needed the baguette. Do you eat it often, Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, now and then.」
Since she's a rich girl, Senpai must eat plenty of fancy Western dishes with fancy names like that.

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, have you ever had beefsteak?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. Sometimes it's served together with this cheese fondue, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Beefsteak with cheese fondue...」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「If I become the Student Council President, do you think I'll get to eat stuff like that all the time?」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't eat it that often, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmmgh...」
It seems beefsteak really is a high-class delicacy that even Ria-senpai doesn't get to eat easily.

name: Ria
message: 「I hope this is the last one...\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai... Come to think of it, wouldn't it have been better if we just listened to the whole tape at once from the start?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, idiot! Apologize! Apologize to Ria-chan right now!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahhh, I'm sorry! Forget I said that! Come on, let's do our best on the next mission!」

name: Ria
message: 「R-Right.」

name: Helena
message: 「Good work. This long battle will likely end with the next one. I'm counting on you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew.」

name: Helena
message: 「The final target is Fish & Chips. Stay sharp. I wish you success.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whew... That was a long errand run.」

name: Ria
message: 「Sorry for dragging you along.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, you really don't need to worry about it.」

name: Paqy
message: 「For Ria-chan's sake, I'd go through fire and water... yeah!」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, Synn-kun. Do you have the stamp card?」

name: Synn
message: 「I think it's in my uniform pocket, though--」

name: Ria
message: 「Then I'll grab it for you.」
Senpai steps right up close to me.

name: Synn
message: 「S-Senpai?!」
Just because my hands are full doesn't mean you can suddenly start groping around in my pocket--that's way too bold!

name: Ria
message: 「Huh? Where is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-N-Not that side, it's the other one, the other one!」
Senpai presses up against me far closer than necessary. And on top of that, she rummages around deep, deep inside, thoroughly feeling around.
Your face is too close, Senpai. Plus, the soft squish of her chest is pressing against my elbow...!

name: Ria
message: 「Found it!」
Completely oblivious to how stimulating that physical contact was, Senpai holds the stamp card up high.

name: Synn
message: 「Haa, haa...」
How can she be so defenseless? At this rate, I feel like I'm going to lose control of myself.
Though I'm one to talk, since I couldn't bring myself to tell her to stop.

name: Ria
message: 「Here you go. Thanks again for today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You're welcome.」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis's selfishness really puts me in a bind.」
Despite saying that, Ria-senpai looks strangely happy.
She probably doesn't actually mind it deep down.

name: Helena
message: 「You were quicker than I expected.」
Helena-san was standing there with her hands on her hips, striking an imposing pose.

name: Ria
message: 「Because Synn-kun came along with me, you see\s07」
Ria-senpai gives a wink so sparkly it wouldn't be strange if stars popped out.

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis. I went and bought it, so hurry up and give back what you took from the fridge!」

name: Helena
message: 「Don't get so worked up over it. It's cute, isn't it?\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「B-Big Sis?! Please stop doing that outside!」
Helena-san really must love everything about Ria-senpai.
Seeing Ria-senpai cross her arms over her chest and puff out her cheeks nearly makes me dizzy.

name: Helena
message: 「Alright, alright, I get it」
We trade what we're holding with each other.

name: Ria
message: 「Wait, this is wine, a baguette, cheese fondue, and fish and chips」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't this the exact same stuff we just bought」

name: Helena
message: 「Yep, seconds」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu. Looks like we're in for another elegant evening tonight\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez, Sis, come on--\s09」
It seems the Kujou family refrigerator is also under Helena-san's complete control.
